book.name: Psalms
book.heading: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
A first-level heading
(2 Samuel 15:13-30)
book.para: O LORD, how many are my foes!
book.heading: A second-level heading
A third-level heading
book.para: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me.
book.heading: A fourth-level heading
book.para: To the LORD I cry aloud.
book.heading: The Beloved
book.para: I will not fear the tens of thousands.
